title: Finite pushforward algebra gives quasi-coherent derived Hom
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $K$ be an object of $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then the sheaf algebra $B=f_*\mathcal O_X$ is pseudo-coherent as an $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], and the derived internal Hom $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(B,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], viewed via its natural $B$-module structure [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module] as an object of $D(B)$, belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(B)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra]; after forgetting the $B$-module structure its image in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y).

source.place: Tag 0AX2, lemma-finite-twisted (using Tags 0AUC and 0AUP for finite pseudo-coherence and quasi-coherence of internal Hom)

proof.text: Substitute the given equality of sheaf algebras B = f_* O_X. Its underlying module is definitionally (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf). Apply isCoherent_unit_of_finite_to_locallyNoetherian and then the coherence clause of isCoherent_pushforward_of_isFinite [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-coherent].

Apply isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] on the Noetherian target to obtain quasi-coherence of B. Apply isPseudoCoherent_singleFunctor_obj_of_isCoherent [lem-sc-coherent-pseudo-coherent] to obtain pseudo-coherence [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex] of B in degree zero.

Apply pseudoCoherentRHomQuasiCoherent [lem-sc-pseudo-coherent-rhom-qcoherent] to B, its quasi-coherence and pseudo-coherence, K.obj, K.property and hK. Mathlib DerivedCategory.Q_obj_single_obj identifies the degree-zero representatives. The lemma supplies the algebra-module derived quasi-coherence, underlying quasi-coherence and underlying lower bound together, for [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module] and [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra]. Package these with the previously proved pseudo-coherence and quasi-coherence witness.
